chunks: Then enter Makkah with tranquility and dignity, having completed everything that was required of you in hajj and Umrah. And buy dates for one dirham and give them in charity, so that it may be an expiation for what may have occurred to you during your ihram from what you do not know.

key_terms.إِحْرَامِكَ: your state of ihram, the sacred consecrated condition of pilgrimage
key_terms.السَّكِينَةُ: tranquility and composure in one’s manner
key_terms.بِدِرْهَمٍ: for one dirham, indicating the amount to be spent
key_terms.كَفَّارَةً: expiation or atonement for a lapse
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, the sacred city entered after completing the pilgrimage rites

ai.seo_question: How should a pilgrim enter Makkah after completing the rites of hajj and Umrah?
ai.summary: This passage instructs the pilgrim to enter Makkah with calmness and dignity after completing the required rites of hajj and Umrah. It also recommends giving charity in the form of dates purchased for one dirham as kaffarah for unrecognized mistakes committed during ihram.
